title: Cardinal Billing Account Rules Manual: One Billing Account for Each Auto Policy
content:
## Section 1. One account per policy

1.1 Every auto policy is billed through exactly one Cardinal Billing Account, opened when the policy is bound.

1.2 A customer therefore holds as many Cardinal Billing Accounts as auto policies. There is no cap of its own on the number of billing accounts a customer may hold.

1.3 A billing account is opened only for a policy that has no billing account yet. Whether a policy already has a billing account is read from the company's billing account records for that policy, before the account is opened; an account in any status (current, notice pending, cancelled for nonpayment, collections or closed) counts as the policy's billing account.

1.4 Accounts are never merged.

## Points of judgement

| Situation (hypothetical) | Result under Section 1 |
|---|---|
| A newly bound policy has no billing account on record | A billing account is opened for it |
| A policy already has a billing account, even a closed one | No second billing account is opened for that policy |
| A customer binds a third auto policy while holding two billing accounts | A third billing account is opened for the new policy; no cap applies |
| A customer asks to combine two policies' accounts into one | Accounts are never merged |

The object compared is the policy: the question is always whether this policy, identified on the company's records, already has its own billing account.
